_metadata.description: Persisted background job states, budgets, cancellation, and opt-in recurring draft generation with quiet notifications.

requirements.title: Jobs are persisted with explicit states and bounds
requirements.description: The scenario should persist jobs in queued, running, waiting_for_review, succeeded, failed, or canceled states, recording workspace, type, deduplication key, input revisions, attempts, provider, budget, result reference, and a safe error code.

validation.notes: Planned: an invented precise completion percentage is unavailable, and a job records meaningful stage progress plus its dedup key (ACT-060).

requirements.title: Retries, cancellation, and outages never duplicate effects
requirements.description: The scenario should retry transient failures with bounded backoff, distinguish extraction success from proposal application, discard or retain a canceled job's late response as canceled evidence, and leave manual editing and deterministic planning operational during a provider outage or exhausted budget.

validation.notes: Planned: cancel, retry, outage, and budget-exceeded paths each produce one terminal outcome and no duplicate application, while manual flows stay usable (ACT-060).

requirements.title: Recurring drafts are opt-in and timezone-correct
requirements.description: The scenario should support opt-in recurring draft generation at a user-selected local time in the profile's IANA timezone, deduplicate a run by workspace, recurrence, and intended local period, and define behavior when the user changes timezone.

validation.notes: Planned: a daylight-saving transition and a retry of the same intended period produce exactly one reviewable draft (ACT-061).

requirements.title: Scheduled runs propose and never act silently
requirements.description: A scheduled run should create a draft for review and should never replace an accepted plan, mark food eaten, alter a supplement schedule, or buy groceries; notifications should default to a quiet in-app badge and deduplicate repetitive or already-dismissed prompts.

validation.notes: Planned: a scheduled run leaves an accepted plan unchanged, produces one draft, and emits no invented consumption or purchase (ACT-061).
